fusions.name: Hibernal Bellow
fusions.desc: Roars, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Enervated] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Maul Through Wards
fusions.desc: A mauling blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Winter Sleep
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds, and 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Fattened Reserves
fusions.desc: The moment your mana is full, you gain a ward worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
